analysis_unit: Turn -> dialogue (8 turns) -> scenario (3 seeds); 10 paired scenarios, 6 families.

adoption.interpretation: Point criterion only; not proof of statistical noninferiority or adoption.

ambiguity_caveat: Interpretation sensitivity bounds, not statistical confidence intervals.

B.segmentation: Auxiliary punctuation/newline segmentation, not a semantic quality judge.

H.segmentation: Auxiliary punctuation/newline segmentation, not a semantic quality judge.

B.interpretation: Scripted action independent of speech, not model sale-decision performance.

H.interpretation: Scripted action independent of speech, not model sale-decision performance.

interface_evidence.actual_generation_template_trace: unconfirmed: messages are not applied-template traces
interface_evidence.server_options: Parent-owned runtime receipt; unchanged options not independently verified here.

limitations: Pilot-unused existing scenarios; not novel-world or training-unseen claims.
Self-generated full dialogue trajectories, not fixed-state recorded-output intervention.
Exploratory exact sign flips on fixed scenarios; no population generalization.
Point candidate, exploratory p values and ambiguity bounds are separate conclusions.
AI-only, nonindependent semantic labels; parent owns reports and process cleanup.
Purchases are scripted after speech; actual buy success is not model sale-decision performance.
Unsafe JSON shapes use the runner's parse-failure fallback; raw parsed values are retained in calls.
